prompt:
Redesign the itinerary travel-segment experience for the existing Korean TripLOG travel planner to greatly improve readability, usability, and design. Show two coordinated mobile UI states side by side: a compact itinerary timeline and the travel-segment editing bottom sheet opened from it. Keep the existing TripLOG brand system: white, dark ink #0b1020, lemon yellow #fff05a, sky blue #bce6fb, pink #f7afc7, thin dark borders, small hard offset shadows, and consistent outline icons. Use the established compact type hierarchy: 22px dialog title, 18px total travel time, 15px place and section names, 14px buttons, 13px field labels, 12px supporting details, and 16px editable values. On the timeline, preserve the left time rail, place cards, day chips, fixed yellow add-schedule action, and bottom navigation. Replace expanded travel forms between stops with compact editable connector rows showing transport, total minutes, and the destination context. Show an empty travel row as “이동 추가” and a populated row as “기차 · 30분”. The bottom sheet has “이동 정보” with a close icon, a compact departure-to-destination summary, one travel segment with a transport dropdown and a duration field with minus-five and plus-five controls, an optional memo disclosure, “환승 구간 추가”, a live total and estimated-arrival summary, and fixed “취소” and yellow “이동 저장” buttons. Keep the sheet short when there is one segment, and make additional segments scrollable. Preserve existing schedule times until the user saves; saving travel details keeps scheduled place times unchanged. Focus the design on readable hierarchy, clear route context, compact controls with comfortable touch targets, and restrained feedback. No destination photographs.

Input images:
- 사진 1.jpg: the user's current itinerary area to improve.
